block_node.block_desc:
Read data from a memory-mapped register of a hardware logic IP core.
The block interfaces with a Register Channel or IO Data Source block and outputs the read data.
Device name and Offset address parameters will be generated by the SoC Builder tool. Set the Output data type and Output vector size parameters to match the equivalents in the register being read.

Write data to a memory-mapped register of the specified hardware logic IP core.
The block accepts data and interfaces with a Register Channel or IO Data Sink block when Output sink parameter is set to To output port. When Output sink parameter is set to Base workspace, the block updates the value of a Simulink.Parameter object in the base workspace. Use this mode when you have tunable parameters mapped to registers in your FPGA model. When Output Sink parameter is set to IP core registers, the block sends the register vaue to an IP Core Register Read block.
Device name and Offset address parameters will be generated by the SoC Builder tool.

Read stream data from a hardware logic IP core.
The block interfaces with a AXI4-Stream to Software or IO Data Source block and outputs the read data.
The Device name parameter is generated by the SoC Builder tool. Set the Samples per frame parameter to determine the number of samples read for each memory transfer. Set the Number of buffers parameter to match the Number of buffer parameter in the AXI4-Stream to Software block.

Write stream data to a hardware logic IP core.
The block receives the write data as input and interfaces with a Software to AXI4-Stream or IO Data Sink block.
The Device name parameter is generated by the SoC Builder tool. Set the Number of buffers parameter to match the Number of buffer parameter in the Software to AXI4-Stream block.

Receive UDP packets sent to a specified local IP port.
The block outputs the received UDP data as a one-dimensional array of the specified data type.
Set the Local IP port parameter to the desired port where the sender sends the UDP data. Set the Data type parameter to match the data type of the incoming UDP data. Set the Receive buffer size parameter to the desired number of data bytes in the received data during simulation.

Send UDP packets to a specified remote IP address and port.
The block accepts a one-dimensional array of type uint8, int8, uint16, int16, uint32, int32, single, or double.
Set the Remote IP address and Remote IP port parameters to the IP address and port of the host where UDP data is to be sent. Set the Local IP port to -1 to use a random available port number to send packets.

Receive TCP/IP packets from another TCP/IP host on an Internet network.
The block accepts and outputs the received TCP/IP data as a one-dimensional array of the specified data type.
Set the Network role to Client to use the block as a TCP/IP client. In client mode, set the Remote IP address and Remote IP port parameters to the IP address and port of the TCP/IP host that sends data.
Set the Network role to Server to use the block as a TCP/IP server. In server mode, set the Local IP port to the port from which the sender sends TCP/IP data. Set Local IP port to -1 to select and use a random available port to receive TCP/IP packets.

Send TCP/IP packets to another TCP/IP host on an Internet network.
The block accepts a one-dimensional array of type single, double, int8, int16, int32, uint8, uint16, or uint32.
Set the Network role to Client to use the block as a TCP/IP client. In client mode, set the Remote IP address and Remote IP port parameters to the IP address and port of the TCP/IP host that receives data.
Set the Network role to Server to use the block as a TCP/IP server. In server mode, set the Local IP port to the port where the host receives TCP/IP data. Set Local IP port to -1 to select and use a random available port to send TCP/IP packets.

ADC Read will fetch the data from ADC result registers.
In the simulation, the block just passes through the inputs. For ADC simulation use ADC Interface block.

PWM Write takes duty cycle input and sets the PWM peripheral according to configuration.
In the simulation, the block just passes through the duty cycle input to drive the PWM Interface block. PWM interface simulates PWM switching signals.

Captures audio from the sound card using ALSA driver framework.
The block outputs audio data as NxC array, where N is the samples per audio channel and C is the number of channels.
Enter the number of channels supported by the device.

Sends audio to the sound card for playback using ALSA driver framework.
The block accepts NxC array of type int8, int16 or int32, where N is the samples per audio channel and C is the number of channels.

Captures video from a USB camera using V4L2 driver framework.
Set Image size parameter to the desired output size. Use Pixel format parameter to specify the format of the intput video stream.
Displays video using Simple Directmedia Layer (SDL) multimedia library. Use Pixel format parameter to specify the format of the output video stream.
